description: Inspect each sculpture to discover its paired target seals, then align stable calibrated 3D sculptures across coupled front and side projections and expose three valid plates.
name: Dual-Projection Sculpture Rig V3 · Difficulty 4 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Start the motors and wait for the fixed calibration to settle. Select a body to reveal its paired target seals and four-second motor forecast; they remain visible for the portfolio. Release without moving (full) or click the same point again (simplified) to inspect safely. Move the stable sculptures so their center dots enter matching target windows in both FRONT (X/height) and SIDE (depth/height) views. Expose each of the three different plates, then certify. Shared tension nudges the other carriages. A misaligned exposure or incomplete certification ends the attempt.
